summary: Blue Owl Technology Finance Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a material definitive agreement: issuance of $150 million aggregate principal 7.60% Series 2026A Senior Notes due 2032 in a private placement to qualified institutional investors. Notes pay semiannual interest, are redeemable at par plus make-whole, and include change-of-control prepayment offers. Covenants include BDC status, minimum net worth, and asset coverage. This is routine corporate debt financing, not a special situation.
